title: Question-Guided Evidence Acquisition for Multimodal Visual Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2608.19739v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal LLMs can see a document, but they often can't read it reliably. Small text, tables, visual cues, and topological elements still trip them up under direct visual inference, even when the page is already sitting in the model's context. Most document-VQA systems treat perception as fixed: they encode the page once, ask the question, and answer from whatever the model happened to extract in that single fast pass. We think document VQA needs slower, more deliberate perception: rather than answering from one fixed encoding, the model should spend a bit of extra compute at inference time working out what to look at next, and only then answer. We build this into \textbf{Q-Guide}, a small agent that reads a question, works out what evidence it is still missing, and calls targeted tool(s) to recover it---reading text where text is needed, zooming in where detail is needed, or grounding a region where position matters. translated_title: 问题引导的多模态视觉问答证据获取
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型能够看到文档，但往往无法可靠地阅读文档。即使在页面已经位于模型上下文中的情况下，小号文字、表格、视觉线索和拓扑元素仍然会在直接视觉推理时使其出错。大多数文档VQA系统将感知视为固定不变的：它们对页面进行一次编码，提出问题，然后根据模型在该次快速扫描中碰巧提取到的内容进行回答。我们认为文档VQA需要更慢、更审慎的感知：模型不应仅基于一次固定的编码进行回答，而应在推理时花费额外计算来确定下一步该看什么，然后再作答。我们将此构建到\textbf{Q-Guide}中，这是一个小型智能体，它读取问题，判断仍缺失的证据，并调用针对性的工具来获取这些证据——在需要文字时读取文字，在需要细节时放大图像，在位置重要时定位区域。在DocVQA2026上，该方法取得了显著效果。
tldr: 本文提出Q-Guide智能体，通过推理时动态引导证据获取，让模型在回答文档视觉问题前先判断并补全缺失信息，从而突破单次固定编码的感知局限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Q-Guide, an agent that dynamically guides evidence acquisition at inference time, enabling the model to identify and recover missing information before answering document visual questions, overcoming the limitations of single-pass fixed encoding.
